zin_elves_is_wall_realm = {
	has_country_flag = zin_elves_wall_realm
}

zin_elves_is_rift_realm = {
	has_country_flag = zin_elves_rift_realm

	has_country_flag = zin_elves_pilgrim_realm

zin_elves_kindred_exists = {
	has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed
}

# The country leads the Kindred of the Woods or sits in the league its leader flag marks.
zin_elves_in_kindred = {
	has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader
		AND = {
			is_in_faction = yes
			any_allied_country = { has_country_flag = zin_elves_kindred_leader }
		}
	}
}

# A realm at war whose state is held by a hand that is not elven.
zin_elves_realm_occupied = {
	has_war = yes
	any_owned_state = {
		NOT = { is_controlled_by = OWNER }
		controller = {
			NOT = { zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes }
		}
	}
}

# A dark power holds one of the realm's states (the diplomacy slice's condition for Break the Refusal).
zin_elves_dark_power_holds_state = {
	any_owned_state = {
		NOT = { is_controlled_by = OWNER }
		controller = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
	}
}

# The Kindred does not exist and the woods may raise it (section 3.2).
zin_elves_kindred_ready = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_elves_kindred_formed }
	OR = {
		check_variable = { var = global.zin_elves_kinship value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
		any_country = {
			zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
			zin_elves_realm_occupied = yes
		}
	}
}

# An eastern host stands in the Magical Lands, or the coalition leader is at war with a rift realm.
zin_elves_eastern_threat = {
	zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
	OR = {
		any_enemy_country = {
			capital_scope = { zin_is_region_east_lands = yes }
			any_controlled_state = { zin_is_region_magical_lands = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			zin_elves_is_rift_realm = yes
			has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
			any_enemy_country = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_leader }
		}
	}
}

# The war condition of the Dragon Pact.
zin_elves_dragon_need = {
	zin_elves_is_magical_realm = yes
	OR = {
		any_enemy_country = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
		zin_elves_eastern_threat = yes
	}
}

# The only reader of the elves' march rule triggers (section 4.3).
zin_elves_marches_by_rule = {
	OR = {
		zin_rules_ai_branch_elves_march = yes
		AND = {
			zin_rules_ai_random_elves = yes
			has_country_flag = zin_elves_ai_marcher
		}
	}
}

zin_elves_date_question = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1 }
			date > 1751.3.1
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1.5 }
			date > 1752.8.30
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0.75 }
			date > 1750.5.31
		}
	}
}

zin_elves_date_feud = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1 }
			date > 1750.3.1
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1.5 }
			date > 1751.3.1
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0.75 }
			date > 1749.8.31
		}
	}
}

# The question of the Refusal is open (section 4.3).
zin_elves_refusal_question_open = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead
		has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named
		has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion
		zin_elves_date_question = yes
	}
}

# The woods may march (section 4.3); never before the question is open.
zin_elves_march_allowed = {
	zin_elves_date_question = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			zin_elves_dark_power_holds_state = yes
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		AND = {
			zin_elves_marches_by_rule = yes
			check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 75 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			any_country = {
				zin_elves_is_elven_country = yes
				any_enemy_country = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
			}
		}
		has_global_flag = zin_zol_manifested
	}
}

# The Keeper employs Perlan or holds Songs for the Wyrms (either tree's spirit).
zin_elves_tends_roosts = {
	OR = {
		has_character = zin_magical_forest_perlan
		has_idea = zin_magical_forest_wyrm_songs
		has_idea = zin_shared_magical_lands_wyrm_songs
	}
}

# The sender has a free Wanderer mission (2, or 3 with the healer focuses).
zin_elves_wanderers_room = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { var = zin_elves_wanderers_out value = 2 compare = less_than }
		AND = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_magical_forest_healers
				has_country_flag = zin_elves_wanderers_extra
			}
			check_variable = { var = zin_elves_wanderers_out value = 3 compare = less_than }
		}
	}
}
